title: the Sundered Sea Rising Anew
author: Xanthe Villalobos
blurb: Odile Villalobos, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
